differences: First serial recovery PID2445882 after approved A010 cleanup. At196 seconds it has no new metric writes, stable972MiB RSS, about146MB process VRAM and one CPU core busy. No numerical model experiment, no optimizer changes or automatic retry.
contrary_evidence: Long initialization can be legitimate. Memory footprint and elapsed time alone do not identify a hang, driver failure or the responsible queued operation. A Python frame identifies location, not cause.
